title: Proof it held
sub: The last film of Only what you may see, the second series of Data protection and privacy: three months after the study's agreement, its first review asks of each line, can we prove it held? Like the vaccine vial monitor, a square that darkens with heat and shows whether the cold held, the platform and the directory keep the proof: who could read (the grants, and the directory's access review), whether every personal column has a class and every class a policy (a check every morning), where the protected columns went (lineage), who read (the audit log), and that access ended on its date.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's look, Night glass: a dark hall of frosted panes, frosted where what's behind may not be read and clear where it may, with cards of near-clear frost and bright rims. Cyan is an identity, green allowed or a proof that holds, coral denied, ended or a gap, violet hidden personal data and its classes, gold only the chip that says the agreement is genuine. Databricks and Microsoft Entra ID are drawn as their pages are laid out, with their names. The vaccine vial monitor is a square inside a circle on a vial's label, in the same night light, with its place and years on a tag.
